18 June 2026

Monetary policy statement

The Governing Council today decided to keep the three key ECB interest rates unchanged.

Economic activity

Economic activity is projected to expand by 1.2% in 2027.

The economy remains resilient.

Inflation

Inflation is expected to stand at 2.1% in 2027.

Core inflation is projected to average 2.3% in 2028.

Labour market

The labour market is tight.

Unemployment is expected to remain at 6.3%.
